markdown_report:
The best first experiment is **content-gated causal dilation inside NextItNet**, targeting stale interests and broadly relevant recommendations that miss recent purpose. This is a hypothesis; no validation improvement has been measured.

**Insights from the starting point.** (1) Users value coherent recent interests, suggesting adaptive context selection. (2) Older isolated interactions persist excessively, suggesting attenuation of distant context. (3) Electronics has 12.27% sampled ranking errors and a −0.2595 lower-tail margin, motivating better contextual discrimination. Embedding scores near 0.5 do not justify collapse regularization.

**Insights from related work.** (1) [NextItNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/1808.05163) supplies causal dilated residual blocks, allowing gates without changing families. (2) [FADC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.05369) motivates adaptive receptive fields, but its vision results do not establish recommendation benefits. (3) [Recformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13731) motivates textual sharing, although its architecture and initialization do not transfer directly. (4) [Sampled-softmax analysis](https://wujcan.github.io/papers/tois-ssm.pdf) motivates stronger candidate competition; training margins remain insufficient evidence of validation gains.

The framework separates three directions: **context selection → causal gates → recent intent**; **item representation → jointly learned text fusion → specific identity**; **ranking supervision → multiple negatives → confusing candidates**. Missing compatibility and replacement-intent labels limit every direction.

Scores below are Originality / Potential / User alignment / Model alignment / Difficulty, each 0–10; higher difficulty means harder implementation. Each assessment includes a strength (+) and limitation (−).

- **A. Content-gated dilation: 5/7/8/6/4.** Originality: + adapts dilation to intent; − familiar gating. Potential: + reusable contextual control; − uncertain gains. User: + targets stale context and broad-purpose mismatch; − cannot establish compatibility. Model: + may distinguish confusing contexts; − margin improvements unproven. Difficulty: + small block modification; − padding requires care.
- **B. Jointly learned title/description fusion: 4/7/7/5/6.** Originality: + constrained textual sharing; − established fusion. Potential: + helps sparse identities; − limited text supervision. User: + exposes functional distinctions; − similarity can reinforce duplicates. Model: + shares statistical strength; − noise may worsen separation. Difficulty: + simple pooling encoder; − vocabulary and predictor serialization expand scope.
- **C. Uniform multi-negative softmax: 3/6/5/8/3.** Originality: + benchmark-specific adaptation; − standard objective. Potential: + straightforward extension; − sampling-sensitive. User: + strengthens specific next-item competition; − no explicit stale-context correction. Model: + directly addresses confusing negatives; − false negatives persist. Difficulty: + localized loss change; − additional memory.

Select **A** at 0% progress: it directly addresses two observed user failures and offers a contextual mechanism for Electronics’ weak separation. Within each residual block, jointly gate short- and long-dilation causal features using only current-prefix features. Initialize toward the baseline path. Preserve the baseline loss initially to isolate the architectural hypothesis.

Use identical training controls and select solely by pinned four-category macro validation HR@10. Track existing margin diagnostics as supporting evidence. Keep one checkpoint per category, synchronized predictor code, causal padding masks, and final-nonpadding readout.

idea.description: Add a jointly trained content-dependent gate between short- and long-dilation causal convolution paths inside the supplied NextItNet residual blocks. Each category remains one network with one checkpoint.
idea.motivation: The user diagnosis identifies stale isolated interests and broad recommendations that miss coherent recent purpose. Adaptive receptive fields could emphasize recent patterns when distant context is distracting. This may also improve contextual discrimination underlying Electronics’ 12.27% sampled wrong-ranking rate, but neither margin nor HR@10 gains are established.
idea.implementation_notes: Extend the supplied corrected baseline rather than reconstructing unavailable host code. Retain its long-dilation path and add a short causal path with matching dimensions. Compute a channelwise sigmoid gate from the block input at each position; initialize its bias toward the existing path. Both paths and gate must use only the current prefix. Mask padding before convolutions and after every residual update. Keep the original training objective, optimizer, sampling, and dilation schedule initially so the experiment isolates gating. Use seed 42, preprocessing seed 0, at most 200 epochs and exactly 200 batches per epoch. Retain all four routes, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], and trial-local artifacts. Serialize gate parameters and architecture configuration and update the embedded predictor writer identically. Preserve log2feats(sequence), item_emb, predict_score(features, items), the actual model through ModelView, DiagnosisProbe(view, device).run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Diagnose only valid positions; unavailable metadata category breakdowns should remain unavailable. Keep timestamps out of this first proposal because the required sequence-only inference contract does not guarantee their delivery. Do not claim duplication or compatibility is resolved. Select using the pinned macro validation HR@10, with diagnostic metrics only supporting interpretation.
idea.pseudocode:
For each category independently:
    initialize supplied NextItNet and added causal short paths/gates
    for each authorized training batch:
        mask = sequence != 0
        h = item_emb(sequence) * mask[..., None]
        for block in model.blocks:
            short = block.short_causal_path(h)
            long = block.original_causal_path(h)
            gate = sigmoid(block.gate(h))
            h = block.combine_residual(h, gate * short + (1 - gate) * long)
            h = h * mask[..., None]
        optimize unchanged baseline next-item objective on valid targets
    select and save one checkpoint using authorized validation
    emit predictor with the same gated architecture

Inference:
    features = model.log2feats(sequence)
    positions = arange(sequence_length)
    final_index = max(where(sequence != 0, positions, -1), axis=1)
    handle empty histories using the supplied baseline convention
    scores = model.predict_score(features[batch_index, final_index], candidates)

originality.positive: Adapts causal receptive fields to observed recent-purpose failures while preserving the NextItNet family.
originality.negative: Gating and adaptive receptive fields are established techniques; this specific adaptation is unvalidated.

future_potential.positive: Provides a small, inspectable mechanism for studying when sequential recommendation benefits from distant context.
future_potential.negative: Next-item supervision may not teach reliable intent changes, and practical compatibility remains unobserved.

code_difficulty.positive: Requires localized convolution and gate additions within one jointly trained model.
code_difficulty.negative: Causal masking, baseline-path initialization, and checkpoint/predictor consistency require careful implementation.

related_work.title: NextItNet
contributions: Uses residual causal dilated convolutions for sequential recommendation.
limitations: Its foundation does not establish that content-dependent dilation improves the supplied benchmark.

related_work.title: Frequency-Adaptive Dilated Convolution
contributions: Provides architectural inspiration for adapting convolutional receptive fields to inputs.
limitations: Evidence concerns vision rather than causal sequential recommendation.

related_work.title: Recformer
contributions: Connects item language representations with sequential recommendation.
limitations: Its Transformer architecture and initialization assumptions do not directly satisfy this NextItNet experiment.

related_work.title: Sampled-softmax analysis
contributions: Motivates ranking objectives with competition among multiple sampled negatives.
limitations: Does not establish improvement for NextItNet on these four categories; sampling and temperature require validation.
